name: Farren's Proof
summary: Farren's Proof is a short delivery mission in Southshore where an adventurer carries a grisly bounty of murloc heads from Lieutenant Farren Orinelle to Marshal Redpath. Having let someone else do the bloody work of hunting the coast, the squeamish lieutenant delegates the actual reporting as well. It marks an intermediate step in securing town recognition along the Hillsbrad coast.

sections.title: A Squeamish Officer
sections.body: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle is tasked with patrolling and securing the southern coastline of Hillsbrad Foothills, yet he has little stomach for the brutal realities of frontier warfare. After sending an adventurer out to cull the rampant murlocs infesting the beaches, he balks at actually touching the severed heads brought back as proof. Rather than personally marching the dripping trophies to Southshore's town command, Farren gladly dumps the errand right back onto the bearer.

sections.title: Report to Redpath
sections.body: Across Southshore, Marshal Redpath oversees the town's defensive operations and military readiness amidst mounting threats from Tarren Mill and wild beast populations. Receiving a sack of murloc heads via courier rather than directly from his lieutenant hardly surprises him. While recognizing that the adventurer has become Farren's errand runner, Redpath is pragmatic enough to accept the assistance, knowing Southshore requires all the diligent labor it can muster to keep its borders intact.

faq.q: Why doesn't Lieutenant Farren deliver the murloc heads himself?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Farren simply has no desire to handle a dripping sack of severed murloc heads. Having already enlisted an adventurer to do the fighting, he finds it far more comfortable to delegate the messy delivery to Marshal Redpath as well.

Marshal Redpath is the senior Alliance military commander stationed in Southshore. He oversees local defense, coordinates town guards, and handles the various regional threats menacing the human settlement in Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Where does this delivery lead next in the quest chain?
faq.answer: Delivering the proof leads to further duties from Marshal Redpath and Lieutenant Farren, culminating in official dispatches regarding troop deployments and paperwork sent back to the capital in Stormwind.

faq.q: Why are murlocs a priority for Southshore's garrison?
faq.answer: Murloc tribes nest densely along the beaches of the Hillsbrad coast. Left unchecked, they raid coastal supply routes, harass local fishermen, and threaten the southern approach to Southshore while the town is already preoccupied with the Forsaken to the north.

faq.q: What does Marshal Redpath think of Lieutenant Farren's conduct?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath is well aware of Farren's habits, dryly noting that the courier has become 'Farren's errand boy.' However, Redpath welcomes the help regardless, as Southshore is hard-pressed and needs any capable labor it can get.

faq.q: Where is Marshal Redpath located in Southshore?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath can be found near the town center and council building in Southshore, keeping watch over the settlement's daily defense operations.

angles.text: Every minor chore in Southshore contributes to keeping the Alliance's primary bastion in Lordaeron fortified against hostile forces encroaching from the north and sea.
For human travelers, dealing with Farren and Redpath offers a candid look at the strained bureaucracy and frontier weariness of the Hillsbrad garrison.
